types.label: Watch a folder
types.description: Starts a run for each new file that appears in one folder, once the file has stopped changing. Files already there when it starts are left alone unless you ask for them.

folder.title: Folder
folder.description: The folder to watch. Folders inside it are not watched.

extensions.title: Only files ending in
extensions.description: Such as .m4a or .md; empty for every file.

settle_ms.title: Wait until quiet (ms)
settle_ms.description: A file is passed on once its size and time have not changed for this long, so a file still being written or copied is never passed on half done.

emit_existing.title: Also pass on the files already there
